title: Python package docs scope
summary: This file is the package-local documentation policy for the Python host package. It does not define the shared public website, shared protocol docs, TypeScript docs, Rust docs, or the GraphReFly blog.
rules: The language-neutral authority lives in ~/src/graphrefly.
The shared graphrefly.dev website shell and public documentation architecture are owned by ~/src/graphrefly under D563.
This repo owns Python package documentation inputs, package-local docs automation, and deployment to https://py.graphrefly.dev/.

title: Repository boundary
rules: ~/src/graphrefly owns shared public docs, guide records, public blog storage/rendering, protocol authority, and dashboard/control views.
~/src/graphrefly-py owns Python docstrings, generated Python API docs, Starlight pages, quickstart, examples, package release notes, and package-local docs checks.
This repo must not hand-maintain mirrors of shared docs, TypeScript docs, Rust docs, public blog posts, or the internal dashboard.

title: Authority order
rules: Protocol rules come from ~/src/graphrefly/spec/rules.jsonl.
Design locks and sequencing come from ~/src/graphrefly/decisions/decisions.jsonl and ~/src/graphrefly/plan/*.jsonl.
Public Python API docs come from docstrings on exported Python package APIs.
Package usage and development notes live in docs/*.md and README material when they are Python-specific.
Shared public concepts and package delegation live in ~/src/graphrefly guide records.

title: Automation policy
rules: Python API docs should be mechanically reproducible from docstrings and package exports.
Generated API docs must not be edited by hand.
Missing-doc and stale-output checks should be generated, not curated manually, once the generator/check exists.
Starlight pages may be hand-written only when they are package-local source docs such as quickstart, install, release, or focused examples.

title: Public Python surface docs
rules: Document public classes, functions, exceptions, message types, and facade methods with structured docstrings when they are user-facing.
Examples must use current clean-slate Python APIs and must not reference retired pre-clean-slate Python core surfaces or old structural parity models.
Protocol-adjacent docs must cite or review the governing rules in ~/src/graphrefly/spec/rules.jsonl.
If Python docs and shared rules disagree, fix the docs or run spec-amend before changing behavior.

title: Package-local material
rules: Python quickstart, API output, examples, Starlight pages, Starlight config, PyPI material, release notes, and py.graphrefly.dev deployment remain package-local.
Shared graphrefly.dev pages may link or delegate to Python docs but must not copy generated API pages, examples, or release notes into the shared site.
Python-specific runtime/lifetime/exception mapping belongs here; shared protocol behavior belongs in ~/src/graphrefly.
